assets.visualReview: Inspected individually on paper and black backgrounds; no people, human hands, human faces or branding
assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, text, numbers, brands, arrows or labels. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: A natural small clump of green seagrass with long narrow strap leaves and a short pale rhizome/root base, isolated specimen, transparent. Botanical seagrass, not kelp or generic terrestrial lawn grass; no labels or water backdrop.

qualification: Plate inspection only. No design edits, speech, renders or lesson approval.
